title: Exactness of the Koszul complex on a generator basic open
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\in\mathbf N$, $f:\mathrm{Fin}(r)\to A$, $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(r)$ and $n\in\mathbf Z$. Extend the Koszul chain complex of [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex] to cochain degrees $-q$, and sheafify it termwise on $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme]. Its restriction as a complex of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] to $D(f_i)$ is exact in degree $n$.

proof.text: Use lem-k3-koszul-generator-homotopy for the chain Koszul complex. Extend its homotopy along embeddingDownNat. Prove degreewise that extension of f_i times the identity equals f_i times the extended identity, using extendMap_f on image degrees and the zero object off the image. Map the homotopy through the additive tilde and open-restriction functors.

Apply lem-k3-basic-open-tilde-scalar-iso to a=f_i and the extended complex. The resulting scalar endomorphism t is an isomorphism. Its homology map is zero by the mapped homotopy and Homotopy.homologyMap_eq, but is also an isomorphism since the homology functor preserves isomorphisms. By isIsoZero_iff_source_target_isZero the homology object is zero; exactAt_iff_isZero_homology yields exactness at n.

theorem koszul_basicOpen_exact
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) (i : Fin r) (n : ℤ) :
    (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i))).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
        _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A))
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r f).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat))).ExactAt n
